name: The engine after a crash
what: When the engine finds one of its own assumptions broken, it stops and starts again from its saved state. After a crash, every operation that was under way is finished or rolled back, and every call the engine had accepted is carried out or fails with a reason.

suggest.why: What Silo promises about crashes holds only if the engine comes back with its state; two of the decisions it needs are still to find out.
